title: Thawing Cryopreserved Human Islets
author: James Lyon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bt6dnra6
materials: A B C D E F 1 Reagent CMRL 1066 Bovine serum albumin 30% Insulin-Transferrin-Selenium (100x) Gibco® GlutaMAX Supplement Penicillin-Streptomycin Mixture 2 Volume 500 ml 8.5 ml 5 ml 10 ml 2.5 ml CMRL 1066 - Corning Catalogue number 15110CV Bovine serum albumiin 30% v/v - Equitech Bio Inc. Catalugue number BAL62 Insulin-Transferrin-Selenium (100x) - Corning Catalogue number 25800CR Gibco® GlutaMAX™ Supplement (100x) - ThermoFisher catalogue number 35050061 Penicillin-Streptomycin Mixture - Lomza Catalogue number 09-757F Prepare Human Islet Culture media as described in the table above. Filter sterilize using a Stericup Sterile Vacuum Filtration System.

steps.title: Prepare M199 Solution (10L)
steps.instruction: Prepare 10L of M199 solution using the specified reagents and pH adjustment.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 9 L of Milli-Q (18mΩ) water into a carboy and store overnight at 4 °C.
Add 9.41g/L M199 powder (Mediatech-Corning 90050PB), 22.0g NaHCO3 (26 mM, Fisher Scientific S233-500), and 23.83g HEPES (10 mM, Fisher Scientific BP310-1) using a stirrer.
Add 50ml Penicillin/Streptomycin (20,000 U/ml penicillin and 20,000 μg/ml streptomycin, Lonza 09-757F) and stir for 30 minutes.
Store the solution overnight at 4 °C to allow powders to dissolve, then stir for another 30 minutes.
Calibrate the pH meter and adjust the solution to pH 7.4 using NaOH and/or HCl.
Bring the final volume to 10L with Milli-Q water (18mΩ).
Filter into 1L bottles using a 0.22µm nitrocellulose filter.

steps.title: Heat Inactivate FBS
steps.instruction: Heat inactivate Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS) and store.

substeps.instruction: Thaw serum and aliquot into labeled 50ml tubes; allow to reach room temperature if thawed in a refrigerator.
Submerge tubes in a water bath set to 56 °C.
Maintain at 56 °C for 30 minutes.
Immediately remove tubes and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Freeze M199
steps.instruction: Prepare the Freeze M199 solution for islet thawing.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 mL heat inactivated FBS (HyClone™ Fetal Bovine Serum (Canada), Characterized - Fisher cat# SH3039603) to 900 mL M199.
Store at 4 °C and warm to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Prepare 0.75M Sucrose Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a sterile 0.75M sucrose solution in Freeze M199.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 12.836 g sucrose into a 50 ml beaker.
Add 30 mL of Freeze M199 and mix until dissolved.
Transfer to a 50 ml volumetric flask and bring the total volume to 50 ml with Freeze M199.
Filter sterilize using a 0.22 um cellulose acetate filter and place on ice.

steps.title: Thaw Cryopreserved Human Islets
steps.instruction: Carefully thaw the islets from liquid nitrogen storage.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from Liquid Nitrogen dewar and place into a portable liquid nitrogen bath.
Immerse and agitate tubes in a 37 °C water bath until almost thawed (remove while a small piece of ice is still present).
Transfer tubes to 0 °C ice slush.
Centrifuge tubes at 282 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute.
Remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash and Dilute Islets
steps.instruction: Gradually wash the islets to remove cryoprotectants using sucrose and Freeze M199.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of cold 0.75M sucrose, lightly hand vortex to resuspend the pellet, and hold on 0 °C ice slush for 30 minutes.
Transfer samples to room temperature for 1 minute.
Add 1 mL of Freeze M199, lightly mix, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add another 1 mL of Freeze M199, lightly mix, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 2 mL of Freeze M199, lightly mix, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 4 mL of Freeze M199, lightly mix, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Recovery and Culture
steps.instruction: Perform final centrifugation and resuspend islets in culture media.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge sample tubes at 282 x g, room temperature, for 1 minute.
Remove supernatant and add 5 mL of Human Islet Culture media; lightly hand vortex to suspend islets.
Culture islets at 22 °C, 5% CO2 using Human Islet Culture media, or use for experiments.
Hand pick islets to purity as soon as possible after thawing.
